verses.1: My child, I write these words to you, so that you may not be deceived. And if anyone is deceived, let us go before our Father Jesus Christ for justice.
verses.2: And this is also a temptation related to our sins; it’s not only related to us alone, but also to the entire world.
verses.3: And in this, we see that we truly know him, if we obey his commands.
verses.4: He who says that I know him and also ignore his commands is a liar. In this case, there is no truth at all.
verses.5: Whoever keeps his word truly accomplishes the love of God. In this way, we realize that we are truly in Him.
verses.6: He who says he must stay there, actually lacks the ability to do so; just as that person also cannot move around freely.
verses.7: Beloved ones, I do not give you any new commands. Instead, I give you those old commands that you have had since the beginning. The old command is the word that you have heard.
verses.8: Once again, I write a new command for you. It is true that both of them exist in reality, and it is also true that darkness is created, while the true light already shines.
verses.9: He said that in the light, his brother whom he hated was still alive in the darkness, until morning.
verses.10: He who loves his brother remains in the light; there is no darkness in him at all.
verses.11: And he who hates his brother in the darkness also wanders in the darkness. He doesn’t know how it happened that the darkness blinded his eyes.
verses.12: I write to you, children, that your sins are forgiven because of His name.
verses.13: I write to you, fathers, that you have known the evil one from the beginning. I write to you, young men, that you have defeated the evil one.
verses.14: I have written to you, children, that you have rejected your father. I have written to you, fathers, that you have rejected the one who was from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, that you are strong, and that the word of God remains with you; therefore, do not accept the evil one.
verses.15: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If someone does love the world, then that love isn’t the love of a father for his child.
verses.16: For everything in this world—the desire for flesh, the desire for sight, and the arrogance of life—it does not come from the father, but from the world itself.
verses.17: And the world is also created, along with its desires. But what God desires to do remains forever.
verses.18: Children, it is a late hour now. As you heard, the antichrist is coming. Now many antichrists have already appeared. From this, we can see that it is indeed a late hour.
verses.19: They came from among us, but they weren’t truly from us. For if they had really come from us, they would have stayed with us. But it must be clear that not everyone comes from us.
verses.20: And you all have a share from the holy one, and you all know this.
verses.21: I did not write to you that you did not know the truth. Instead, I said that you did know it. And that all lies cannot be true.
verses.22: Who is this liar, if not someone who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This person is the Antichrist, someone who denies both the Father and the Son.
verses.23: Anyone who denies having a son also doesn’t have a father. But those who admit to having both a son and a father do indeed have them.
verses.24: What you have heard from the beginning, I will give to you. If what you have heard from the beginning remains with you, then you will also remain with it, both in your son and in your father.
verses.25: And this is the message he delivered to us: eternal life.
verses.26: These I write to you about the plovones.
verses.27: And the mark that you have received from him remains with you. There is no need for anyone to teach you anything. Instead, let his mark teach you everything. It’s true, and there’s no deception involved. And as he has taught you, remain in that mark.
verses.28: And now, children, remain in him, so that when we are revealed, we may show forth our glory, and not be accused by him in his presence.
verses.29: If you know that it is just, then remember that every person who practices justice is born from it.
